Also, Kevin is an ancestor of Danielle → Stephanie, so Kevin is an ancestor of Stephanie.

Therefore, **Kevin and Nicholas share a common descendant (Stephanie).**

I traced their lineage back through several generations, confirming they both lead to Stephanie. However, without a direct chain linking Kevin and Nicholas, I can't infer that one is an ancestor of the other. So, I can confidently state they share Stephanie as a common descendant!
